classification.difficultyReason: Identify simple regions and add their areas or subtract unshaded holes, using perpendicular measurements.

spec.description: A shaded parallelogram on the left shares its right sloping edge with a rectangle extending down and right. Dimension arrows show the parallelogram's horizontal base and vertical height and the rectangle's outer long side. Right-angle marks occur at both ends of the shared edge.
spec.mathematics: Parallelogram base 14 cm and perpendicular height 6 cm; rectangle sides 12 cm and 8 cm. Add their areas.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied measurements and marks appear; the answer is stored separately.

answer.worked:
Add the areas of the parallelogram and rectangle.
$$\begin{align*}A_1 &= 14\times6\\A_1 &= 84\text{ cm}^2\\A_2 &= 12\times8\\A_2 &= 96\text{ cm}^2\\A_{\text{total}} &= 84+96\\A_{\text{total}} &= 180\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: A shaded parallelogram on the left joins a long rectangle extending down and right. Both visible 8 cm labels are retained, including the transverse double-ended width arrow within the rectangle. The source figure's illustrative proportions are retained.
spec.mathematics: Parallelogram base 23 cm and perpendicular height 7 cm; rectangle length 22 cm and width 8 cm. The repeated 8 cm labels identify the same rectangle width.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied measurements appear; the answer is stored separately.

answer.worked:
Add the areas of the parallelogram and rectangle.
$$\begin{align*}A_1 &= 23\times7\\A_1 &= 161\text{ cm}^2\\A_2 &= 22\times8\\A_2 &= 176\text{ cm}^2\\A_{\text{total}} &= 161+176\\A_{\text{total}} &= 337\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: A shaded horizontal rectangle contains a white tilted parallelogram. External arrows give the outer rectangle's dimensions. A lower sloping arrow labels the inner base, and the internal height arrow is perpendicular to that base.
spec.mathematics: Outer rectangle 23 cm by 12 cm; inner parallelogram base 12 cm and perpendicular height 7 cm. Subtract the parallelogram area.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied measurements appear; the answer is stored separately.

answer.worked:
Subtract the unshaded parallelogram from the rectangle.
$$\begin{align*}A_1 &= 23\times12\\A_1 &= 276\text{ cm}^2\\A_2 &= 12\times7\\A_2 &= 84\text{ cm}^2\\A_{\text{shaded}} &= 276-84\\A_{\text{shaded}} &= 192\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: The source's tilted outer silhouette has long sides sloping down and right and contains two white rectangular holes. The upper hole is nearer the right side; the lower hole is nearer the left side. The outer transverse dimension is perpendicular to its long sides.
spec.mathematics: Outer region length 38 cm and perpendicular width 18 cm. Upper rectangular hole 9 cm by 4 cm; lower rectangular hole 12 cm by 4 cm. Subtract both hole areas.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied measurements appear; the answer is stored separately.

answer.worked:
Subtract both unshaded rectangles from the outer region.
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{outer}} &= 38\times18\\A_{\text{outer}} &= 684\text{ cm}^2\\A_{\text{upper}} &= 9\times4\\A_{\text{upper}} &= 36\text{ cm}^2\\A_{\text{lower}} &= 12\times4\\A_{\text{lower}} &= 48\text{ cm}^2\\A_{\text{shaded}} &= 684-36-48\\A_{\text{shaded}} &= 600\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
